dedupe_keys.name: data and code repository flood exposure assessment in sub saharan african cities

description: Lorraine Trento Oliveira at the University of Twente publishes the inputs, outputs and Python notebooks for assessing flood exposure in deprived urban areas of sub-Saharan African cities. The archive combines administrative and basin boundaries, precipitation tables, community flood observations, building layers and modelled inundation outputs on a 50 by 50 metre grid. It includes intermediate overlays, absolute and relative exposure counts, and a comparison of modelled flooding against surveyed observations. The June 2025 deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. Named city coverage and observation dates remain unknown in the public description. Reuse requires editing notebook paths; obtaining new precipitation inputs can depend on TAHMO staff. The workflow supports exposure analysis and validation of urban flood simulations. Google Open Buildings is a named input already represented in the catalogue; technical compatibility was not tested.
